name: In the Palace of the Birds
source:
Three friends stuck in a room. A girl climbing a mountain. A game, a story, a siren to the tune of A.

Can you see it? Can you see the moon?

[From [url=https://tsundokudiving.itch.io/in-the-palace-of-the-birds]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三个朋友被困在一个房间里。一个女孩正在爬山。一个游戏，一个故事，A曲调的警笛。

你能看到吗？你能看到月亮吗？

[来自[url=https://tsundokudiving.itch.io/in-the-palace-of-the-birds]itch.io[/url]]
